verdict.rationale: Elastic docs say that indexing into a `semantic_text` field automatically generates embeddings with a configured ML model. They add that no model settings or inference ingest pipelines are needed, and that external or hosted embedding models can be deployed, with the inference API available for finer control. This covers the core of using built-in or managed embedders instead of running your own pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that query-time text is auto-vectorized, named Elastic-managed default models or providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
